lina: Quick rehearsal note — captions were ~6s behind slides in the last run. If that persists we should (1) pause captions and use manual VTT export, or (2) delay slide advance by 5s. Thoughts?

devon: ugh, yeah i saw that. probably the caption pipeline queueing. we can export VTT as backup.

kevin: i'd prefer delaying slide transitions by 4-6s during live Q&A only, avoids awkward scrub. ops-bot: can you schedule a T-5 check for captions latency?

ops-bot: scheduled reminder set for T-5: "caption latency check".

sophie: on followups: i'll compile leadership questions post-call. can we add an "owner" column so we know who responds?

lina: yes — add owner + "product/eng/sales" tag. during go-live: if captions >4s delay, flip to manual VTT and note timestamp in thread.

kevin: noted. i'll be on the call to nudge slide timing if needed. keep the fallback simple. :thumbsup:
